title: Show HN: I created an After Effects alternative
author: clementpiki
excerpt: Many years ago, I made VJ softwares (to mix live visuals in clubs) for unexpected platforms like the Game Boy Advance, the Playstation 2 and the Raspberry Pi. This year, I’m back with a new web-app: Pikimov. Inspired by Photopea (a free Photoshop clone), I created this web-based motion design & video editor as an alternative to After Effects, to fill empty void. It's free, without signup, without cloud uploads (your files stay on your machine), and your projects are not used
guide_zh: Pikimov 提供免费、免注册且文件留在本地的网页动效与视频编辑。
